body: Bermuda is a British overseas territory, located north of the Caribbean Sea. It counts as the United Kingdom for country streak purposes.
Bermuda drives on the left side of the road.
Bermuda features a black Street View car, often with the entire front sides of the vehicle visible.
Bermuda's landscape features dense vegetation with small trees and bushes, along with many single-family houses.
Bermudan licence plates are long, all-white with black digits centered in the middle.
Most roads in Bermuda have a single solid yellow middle line and no outer lines.
White zig-zag road lines can occasionally be seen in Bermuda.
Most buildings are single-family stone houses painted in pastel colours. A very distinct feature is their completely white roofs.
Palm trees are very common in Bermuda.
Being an island, you are never far from the ocean, which often has a distinctly light blue color.
Hamilton, the largest town, is recognizable by its many large, densely built multi-floor buildings.
The northwestern tip of Bermuda features many large buildings made of unpainted grey brick.
A boat trekker provides coverage on the eastern coast, around Saint George’s Harbour and past Fort St. Catherine.
